[A10] MEASUREMENT ONLY - DO NOT MERGE

Temporary acceptance-5 experiment for issue #407 and implementation PR #505. This branch contains implementation head 6af65a151663e1301f1983a6c9d22650a0b35da9 plus exactly one intentional mutation: append `|| true` to docs-check's bare Python idiom gate command. Mutation head: 66ba210630ff7f412e5706427b3ea976ebee3ba2.

Expected outcomes under the standard trusted live-dev act runner: the tampered idiom step succeeds; docs-check's own contract step and full-ci-gate's contract step refuse the changed script by job/step/line; the entire docs-check job and both exhaustive aggregates fail. Run docs and rtl-full separately because the runner stops after a failed workflow. Native/hosted failures on this scratch branch are intentional experiment results, not implementation gate failures or approval.

The normal implementation PR independently owes all required green evidence. This scratch PR will be closed without merging after immutable receipts are published. It closes no issue and receives no merge authorization. The method follows the recorded #406 precedent: https://github.com/kebag-logic/milan-fpga/pull/431#issuecomment-5648862274 .
